in_hebrew.name: Rudy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Famous wolf, ruler
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rudy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Rudy is derived from the Germanic elements rud, meaning 'fame' or 'reputation', and hild, meaning 'battle' or 'war'. The name was popular among the Germanic tribes and was borne by several early saints. In medieval Europe, the name became associated with the legend of Saint Rudolph, who was said to have driven the invading Magyars from the region now known as Hungary.
